jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About ExTrac
 ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.
 Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai .
 
 The Role
 We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of major areas of ExTrac's AI-driven platform. Reporting into ExTrac's Head of Product, you will work closely with the design, engineering, research and analysis, and customer success teams to take significant product areas from ambiguity to shipped: leading discovery, defining requirements, driving delivery, and bringing order to the tools and processes that product work runs on.
 ExTrac is a founder-led, vision-led company. This role : owning prioritisation within your product areas, keeping stakeholders aligned as plans evolve, and acting as a multiplier for product craft across the teams you work with.
 
 What the job involves 
 Roadmap ownership 
 Own the roadmap for our core SaaS platform, translating the strategy set by ExTrac's founders and product leadership into a clear, sequenced, deliverable plan.

 Own prioritisation within your area, balancing user needs, business goals, BD requirements, and specific client requirements, and defending those calls with evidence and reasoning.

 Stay across all work in flight within your areas: who is working on what, expected timelines, and what is paused, delayed, or blocked.

 Stay close to industry trends and competitor products, especially in AI and B2B SaaS, and feed that intelligence into roadmap discussions.

 Discovery and definition 
 Lead feature development from concept to delivery, with clear and actionable PRDs.

 Conduct investigations, gather information, and assess feasibility.

 Keep all stakeholders aligned and up to date as plans and requirements evolve.

 Product operations and delivery 
 Bring order to the tools and workflows that product development runs on (issue tracking, documentation, sprint and delivery processes), so they reflect how we actually work and scale as we grow.

 Own the interface between product management and delivery management within your areas: sequencing, dependencies, and visible progress against commitments.

 Establish the working hygiene (clearly structured initiatives, honest status, well-maintained backlogs) that lets engineering, design, and leadership trust the plan.

 Technical and data judgement 
 Apply technical judgement to guide product development within your areas, especially around AI/ML model integration, data processing, and analytics.

 Translate complex technical solutions into clear product decisions and communicate the trade-offs to stakeholders.

 Use behavioural data and analytics as a key input to decisions and prioritisation, alongside domain expertise and conviction.

 Research, validation and data 
 Use usage analytics and behavioural data to track adoption and surface friction within your product areas, and build workflows to analyse and act on it.

 Favour observation over interrogation: watching people work usually tells you more than asking them what they want.

 Use user research and testing for what it does well, validating legibility, usability, and workflow fit. This evaluative feedback should carry real weight and is often decisive; workflow fit deserves particular care given our high-stakes users.

 Recognise the limits of research when it comes to direction: what we should build is synthesised from deep expertise across intelligence analysis, subject matter, data science, engineering, and design.

 For bets that cannot be validated up front, apply post-deployment discipline: define success metrics and evaluation timelines, commit in advance to the evidence that would change your mind, and assess honestly whether the bet is paying off.

 Organise and run internal alpha and beta testing, plus external testing where possible; partner with Customer Success to recruit proxy users and to surface the friction, workflow issues, and pain points that feed into execution and prioritisation.

 Working with AI: Co-Analyst 
 Partner closely with the AI team to ensure AI features are genuinely useful, understandable, and aligned with what our users need.

 Help track and document the specific behaviours and styles built into Co-Analyst responses.

 Support the work to adapt Co-Analyst to the needs of specific external organisations.

 Raising the bar for product practice 
 Contribute to the product function's processes, roadmapping systems, and prioritisation frameworks, and model their consistent use.

 Help define and track the metrics that indicate product success, adoption, and customer satisfaction

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
Our Mission 
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?
 Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.
 We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.
 The Role
 You’ll own the product roadmap for Dex. That covers our candidate product, our client product, our internal tools and the ML systems behind all of them.
 Our team moves fast. Your job is to point that speed at the right problems and keep a clear lookahead: what’s next, and what’s coming over the horizon.
 Ideas at Dex come from design, engineering, our talent team, clients and candidates. You’ll pull them together, decide what matters most, and turn that into a plan we can deliver.
 You'll report to our Head of Engineering and work closely with our founder, as well as across the whole business.
 The divide between product managers and engineers has never been thinner, you’re excited by how AI is changing our roles and are excited to be part of how the products of the future are built. 
 You’re AI pilled, you run agents, you tinker and are excited about technology in general
 
 What You'll Do
 Own the roadmap. Our candidate product, client product, internal tools and the ML systems that power them are all connected. You'll own how they move forward together.

 Partner with engineering and design. Work closely with our engineers and designers as the work gets done, from scoping through to shipping.

 Build for our talent experts. Our internal talent experts are at the core of our business. Work alongside them to build a platform that makes them better at what they do.

 Run delivery. Own our planning sessions and our roadmap in Linear. Make sure we have a plan, even if it might change, so we always know what’s next and roughly what’s after.

 Do the analysis. Understand what we stand to gain from each piece of work in terms of metrics, set the hypothesis upfront, and work with the people doing the work to confirm or reject it.

 What We're Looking For
 A strong technical PM. You've worked in product at an early-stage company, and you were likely an engineer before that.

 Delivery focused. You care deeply about moving fast and shipping.

 Great with stakeholders. You're comfortable with candidates, clients and our internal recruitment team, and you keep all three at the heart of what gets built.

 Use data, but aren't beholden to it. You make data-driven decisions where you can, and you're not afraid to make the call when the data isn’t there.

 Bring consistency and rhythm. You help give the team a rhythm for how we plan and ship, so everyone knows what’s happening and when.

 Forward thinking with AI. You're all in on AI, you build with it and you tinker in your own time.

 Nice to Have
 ML systems experience, especially recommendation, search or matchmaking

 Marketplace experience

 RecTech or HRTech experience

 What We Offer
 Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition

 Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take

 Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you

 Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support

 Gym membership & wellness benefits

 Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens

 Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip

 MacBook Pro + team kit

 "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support

 Interview Process
 We move quickly and with conviction. Broadly you can expect:
 We love it when candidates have experimented with our agent, Dex. Even if you aren't an Engineer, you can get a sense of what we're building, and we love to hear your feedback.

 A 30m video call with our Internal Talent Lead; we'll share more about the team, role and business before asking questions about your experience and fit.

 Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements.

 Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager - H/F
jobs.description:

 Chez Hubvisory, le Lead PM intervient chez nos clients grands comptes quand il faut plus qu’un bon PM : quelqu’un capable de reprendre une organisation produit en main, de remettre de la clarté dans la roadmap et de faire monter l’équipe en compétences.
 
 🎯 Concrètement, tu vas : 
 Prendre des missions de Lead PM ou de Head of Product par intérim, avec des directions qui attendent des arbitrages clairs

 Coacher les PM et PO de tes clients, sur leurs vrais sujets, pas en salle de formation

 Revoir la façon dont une organisation fait du produit : process, rituels, operating model, Product Ops

 Parler budget et ROI avec tes interlocuteurs, et suivre la mise en marché de ce qui sort

 Accompagner les Hubvisors plus juniors. Tu donneras aussi un coup de main sur les recrutements et les rendez-vous commerciaux, à ce niveau ça fait partie du rôle
 

 🧭 Et ensuite ? Après le Lead, deux voies s’ouvrent : Manager, si tu as envie d’accompagner une équipe de consultants, ou Principal, si tu préfères aller au bout de l’expertise.
 
 💡 Pourquoi Hubvisory ? 
 On ne fait que du Product & IA, depuis 2016. Avec l’IA, coder et rédiger des US coûte de moins en moins cher. Ce qui fait la différence, c’est de savoir quoi construire, et c’est ton métier.

 Tu travailles pour Dior, Decathlon, Leroy Merlin, France TV…

 Ton salaire est revu deux fois par an

 Jusqu’à 22 % des profits redistribués en intéressement, la même part pour tout le monde

 Parental Challenge : salaire maintenu à 100 % pendant ton congé parental
 

 💰 Rémunération : entre 52 000 et 68 000 € (selon grade) brut annuel fixe, avec intéressement et primes en plus (commerciale, ancienneté sur mission, cooptation).
 
 👤 Ce qu’on attend de toi 
 Au moins 4 ans en Product Management, dont une expérience où tu as encadré des PM ou tenu un rôle de Head of Product

 Une vraie maîtrise de la Discovery comme de la Delivery. OKR, roadmap, story mapping : tu les utilises au quotidien, pas seulement en atelier

 Tu as déjà fait évoluer les pratiques produit d’une organisation, et tu sais défendre un budget

 Un passage en conseil, des produits IA ou un bon niveau d’anglais, c’est un plus

 Côté posture : tu sais embarquer des gens qui ne dépendent pas de toi, tu tiens ta position face à un COMEX, et tu es exigeant(e) sans être dur(e)
 

 🔄 Le process 
 Un premier échange avec l’équipe RH

 Un cas pratique en live avec un Manager (1h30)

 Un entretien avec un VP ou un cofondateur, plus orienté stratégie et posture (1h30)

 Un dernier call RH de 15 minutes pour la proposition

 Tu rejoins l’équipe produit d’un de nos clients grands comptes, et c’est toi qui as la main sur ton produit. D’une mission à l’autre, tu changes d’univers : retail, luxe, banque, secteur public. Peu de postes te font voir autant de contextes en si peu de temps.
 
 🎯 Tes missions 
 Discovery : tu vas voir les utilisateurs, tu mènes les entretiens et tu valides tes hypothèses avant de lancer quoi que ce soit en dev

 Conception : tu construis les solutions avec les designers, du prototype jusqu’aux tests utilisateurs

 Partage : tu présentes ce que tu as appris en mission aux autres PM Hubvisory, et tu profites de ce qu’ils ont appris eux aussi

 We build with AI. Our designers build and maintain front-end experiences themselves, directly in Claude Code. PMs test working prototypes with clients before development starts.
 We discover with AI. We regularly co-design experiences with customers using vibe coding: we build and change the prototype with them, in the same session.
 What this means for you:
 Short loops. An idea goes from a client call to something clients can click in days.

 Real ownership. You own the problem, the customer and the go-to-market, not only the backlog.

 Room to grow. AI skills are part of our career ladder. As a Senior PM, you will build skills and agents the whole team uses, and help set how PMs work with AI at UpSlide.
 

 Team goals 🎯

 Send a weekly update an exec can read in 2 minutes.

 Mentor 1 or 2 PMs and interview candidates.

 Set the quality bar for AI (20%)

 Set the quality standard our regulated finance clients expect, and make it reusable for other AI features.

 Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.
 We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.
 Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.
 We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.
 Not your grandad’s bookie.
 👀 The Role 
 Title: Lead Product Manager 
 Team: Product - Core 
 Location: United Kingdom, Remote
 Core is the foundation that every Midnite customer and product depends on. As we grow, we're organising Core around two journeys: getting new players from sign-up to their first deposit, and keeping them once they're with us. This role leads the second.
 You'll own Core Engagement: a player's life with Midnite after they've made their first deposit, and every point where friction could cost us a good customer. That includes some of the hardest moments in our product, such as affordability and enhanced due diligence checks, limits and suspensions, safer gambling interventions, and location and self-exclusion checks. It also includes the everyday Core experience players touch every week: their account, transactions, login and security, navigation, safer gambling tools and support. And it includes keeping fraud out without getting in the way of genuine players.
 You will: 
 Own Core Engagement end to end, from strategy and discovery through to delivery and continuous improvement, measured on how many players we keep after key Core friction.

 Build the data foundation for it: how many players hit a limit, check or restriction, when, and how many we lose afterwards. Then set targets, stay disciplined on a small number of key results, and move them through constant experiments and small, frequent improvements rather than waiting for big projects.

 Lead our in-life regulated journeys, including affordability and EDD, limits and other safer gambling interventions, geolocation and self-exclusion checks, and fraud risk scoring, along with the partners behind them.

 Own the everyday Core experience: account and settings, transactions UI, login and MFA, the app shell (top navigation and footer), safer gambling tools, notification opt-in and the help and support experience.

 Work hand in hand with the teams either side of you: Onboarding and Activation, which owns everything up to a player's first deposit, and Nucleus, which owns the back-office compliance and safer gambling operations behind your journeys.

 Build capabilities that are set per market rather than rebuilt for each one, across the UK, Ireland, Canada and future Midnite markets.

 The next Midniter: 
 You're an experienced Product Manager with 6+ years' experience who has owned complex products end to end with measurable outcomes, ideally within a high-growth technology company.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager | London
jobs.description:
We Are 
 Breaking The Law
 
 
 
 LawAdvisor was founded in 2015 in Melbourne, Australia with a fearless and ambitious belief: that everybody should have access to justice. 
 We hypothesised that the high costs, inefficiencies, and difficulties of obtaining legal help could be overcome simply by providing greater access to legal information, and by providing everybody with real-time access to high-quality, affordable lawyers online.
 Our mission has since been supported by thousands of lawyers and has allowed us to expand and set up offices across the globe. We've also attracted high-profile investors and partners who have shared our mission to transform legal service delivery.
 
We're still not satisfied. The potential exists to completely revolutionise the practice of law. The start of this decade has delivered LawAdvisor with a new mandate: to overhaul and transform how lawyers work, and how people interact with and consume legal services, with state-of-the-art legal practise management technology to (i) increase efficiencies; (ii) automate routine processes; (iii) increase transparency; (iv) bring the legal practice to the 21st century.
 

 
 We Need
 
 A Novice Juggler 
Our Associate Product Manager relishes in the idea of being a part of a team that moves mountains. They know better than to falter when opportunities aren’t handed to them because they know that nothing good will ever come easy. Remaining steadfast and diligent, they’re prepared to get their hands dirty and navigate through the variety of tasks that they’ll take ownership over.
 

 Teaming up with our Product Managers, you’ll solve problems and facilitate communication across our cross-functional team and align them in order to shape, influence, and refine our products. An intimate understanding of our market and product suite helps us surmount any obstacle facing us whether it may be competitors, client and stakeholder feedback, or the creation of new products and features. You’ll be ready to learn from the best and continuously supercharge your professional growth and knowledge through our resources, tools, and first-hand experience.
 
 
 You Will 

 Be the professor of our users’ “pain points”. You empathise with our clients and can describe the problems we are trying to solve.

 Collaborate with and manage the product development team alongside the Product Manager.

 Gather, analyse, and apply our quantitative and qualitative data and feedback to elevate our products.

 Ideate new solutions and opportunities as well as analyse research with the product team to determine how it can align with our product goals.

 Help facilitate communication within cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle from conceptualisation to launch day and beyond.

 Use your in-depth understanding of our products to deliver training to our internal teams and external stakeholders to promote optimal product knowledge.

 Learn and grow: gain knowledge and experience through watching and/or participating in the creation of product roadmaps, product strategy, and product plans as they happen.

 Become a leader: you gain first-hand experience through the Product Manager on how to delegate, manage and lead cross-functional teams to product success.

 
 You Should Have 

 A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Business Management, Marketing, a similar related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 Experience working both autonomously and in cross-functional teams.

 Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills: you are an essential part of our communication as you harmonise the voices, needs, and concerns of our stakeholders, product team, and clients.

 The ability to build domain and industry knowledge quickly.

 

 Bonus Points 

 Thrive under pressure.

jobs.description:
About Rivia 
 Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital.
 Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated.
 Over the past two years, European and US based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital.
 Rivia’s ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end.
  
 About the Product Team 
 You’ll be Rivia's first product hire, reporting to the CTO. Today, everything Product is owned by the Rivia founders and carried out Engineering. Your job is to take it over, build the function, and make shipping high quality products repeatable. As Rivia scales, there is a clear path to leading a PM team.

 As Senior Product Manager at Rivia, you own the path from idea to adopted feature. Driving alignment across Engineering, Client Solutions and founders to build products that have relevant impact, from customer discovery, mockups, specs, weekly refinement, launches, and measurement of KPIs.

To do that you’ll need to be deep in the details: talking to customers, experts, writing specs, monitoring usage, keeping delivery moving. You also build the product management function itself, with light processes (PRDs, documentation, releases, prioritization) that a future product team builds on, and you own product coherence: the principles that keep features consistent as the platform grows.

 Shipping products that help bring new therapies to market. Our customers entrust us with their patients, we take that very seriously.

 Working directly with customers, including clinical research and biotech teams running global clinical trials, to understand problems and turn them into delightful solutions.

 Product Function Building: Set up light processes (PRDs, documentation, release process, prioritization) that the team actually follows.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The Virtual Private Cloud team develops the core networking layer of Nebius AI Cloud.

We provide secure and isolated private networks, connectivity from cloud resources to internet and external networks, and networking services such as routing, security groups, load balancing and VPN connectivity.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive complex initiatives spanning VPC, adjacent cloud services, and infrastructure layers. These may include launching VPC in new regions, supporting new hardware generations, improving platform scalability and resilience, evolving service architecture, and delivering new customer-facing networking capabilities.

You will work closely with developers, engineering managers, technical leads and product managers of VPC and adjacent teams. You will turn broad product and technical objectives into executable programs, define outcomes and acceptance criteria, expose dependencies and trade-offs, facilitate timely decisions, and coordinate delivery through validation, rollout, and operational readiness.
 

Requirements

  1. 5+ years of experience in technical program management, technical project management, engineering management, or a senior technical role involving the delivery of complex cross-team initiatives.
  2. A strong technical background: you should be able to participate meaningfully in discussions about cloud networking and distributed systems, understand system boundaries and failure modes, and challenge assumptions without needing to be the primary architect.
  3. Practical knowledge of networking fundamentals such as IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, routing, network isolation, NAT, firewalls and load balancing. You should be comfortable learning and reasoning about the architecture of a production cloud-networking platform.
  4. Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly, facilitate decisions, and produce concise, actionable documentation.
  5. Proven experience coordinating initiatives involving multiple engineering teams with different priorities and dependencies.
  6. Ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify critical paths, manage risks, and adapt plans as requirements change.
  7. A practical, outcome-oriented approach and the ability to drive progress without relying on formal authority.
 

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience building or operating public-cloud or other large-scale infrastructure.
  • Experience with VPCs, SDN, network virtualization, or Linux networking.
  • Experience leading programs focused on reliability, scalability, or operational improvement.
  • Experience designing lightweight planning, risk-management, or operational-readiness processes for engineering organizations.

 

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit 
 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in the Netherlands . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in the Netherlands .
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
About Doit 
 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. 
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. 
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
 
 The Role 
 Doit is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
  

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
  

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
  

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

jobs.title: Product Marketing & Growth Lead
jobs.description:
About Payflows 
Payflows is the AI companion that makes a company's existing ERP AI-native, so finance teams can close faster without the pain of migrating from their legacy tools. Founded in Paris in 2022, we have raised €26M from Balderton, Ribbit Capital and Headline, and work from hubs in Paris, London and New York. We work with mid-cap and large enterprises, private equity firms and organisations helping businesses transform their finance operations.
 
 Why we're hiring 
 We want Payflows to be the first brand people think of when they think about AI in enterprise finance and creating the continuous close. 
 Today, our sales and partnerships teams tell a compelling story to CFOs, finance leaders, private equity firms and consulting partners every week. But we're only reaching a fraction of the people who need to hear it. 
 We need someone to change that. Someone who can take a deep understanding of our product, the problems it solves and the story our GTM team tells, and find creative ways to bring it to the entire market: through product demonstrations, videos, interactive experiences, campaigns, customer stories, thought leadership and ideas we haven't thought of yet. 
 Your job is to figure out how to make every relevant audience understand, experience and get excited about Payflows. 
 
 The role 
 You'll make every audience that matters to Payflows understand, experience and get excited about what we do: enterprise buyers, finance leaders, PE operating partners, consulting partners and the wider finance and technology community. You'll spend time understanding the product, listening to customers, joining sales and partnership calls and learning how we win. You'll be given a story to start from, and you can of course refine it. 
 You'll be part product expert, part creator, part growth marketer and part chief storyteller. Some days you'll be producing a product video. Others you'll be designing an interactive AI experience, building a campaign for private equity operating partners, creating a customer use case or finding a completely new way to get Payflows in front of the market.

 What you'll do 
 Know the product inside out. Spend time with our product and engineering teams. Understand what we're building, how it works and why it matters. You need to be able to explain our product better than almost anyone outside the engineering team.

Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimise operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimised consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

 

Overview

As a Technical Product Manager, you support and drive strategic product initiatives. You quickly build a clear understanding of platform technical capabilities and limitations to translate business needs into precise requirements. You help manage projects from planning through launch, maintaining end-to-end ownership across roadmap development, release readiness, and post-launch enablement. You work closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Client Success teams to prioritize and deliver impactful solutions. You use data, client feedback, and market insights to make informed product decisions, improve product value, and support successful adoption.

Rithum expects employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and create scalable ways of working.

 

Responsibilities

  • Support Senior Product Manager across strategic operations workstreams.
  • Translate business priorities into clear technical product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans, leading scoping calls and producing crisp written outputs.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, UX, and Client Success to define, prioritize, and deliver high-impact capabilities.
  • Drive execution across discovery, planning, development, testing, release, and post-launch iteration, taking end-to-end ownership of roadmap development projects from requirements through delivery, release readiness, and post-development documentation and enablement.
  • Establish and maintain an intake and triage rhythm for enhancement requests and operational work, ensuring consistent capture of context, impact, dependencies, and recommended priority for leadership decisions.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized view of top platform risks and recurring operational gaps, surfacing risks early and clearly to product leadership to support prioritization decisions.
  • Manage cross-functional alignment, dependencies, timelines, risks, and status reporting across multiple initiatives.
  • Analyze data, client feedback, and market signals to inform product decisions and improve feature value.
  • Oversee product documentation, release notes, internal enablement materials, and stakeholder communications.
  • Support client and internal team discussions to clarify requirements, validate use cases, and ensure successful adoption.
  • Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, etc.) to accelerate and elevate outcomes, including communication drafting, data analysis, prompt engineering, and documentation.

 

Qualifications 

Minimum Qualifications  

  • 2+ years of Technical Product Management or Product Management experience at a software company.
  • Experience working on ecommerce or marketplace products.
  • Experience working closely with Engineering and Data Science teams on APIs, data workflows, analytics, or automation capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous requests into clear requirements (user stories, acceptance criteria, and documentation) and drive work to completion across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience reading and interpreting API requirements and technical documentation (REST concepts, authentication patterns, payloads, and webhooks fundamentals).

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Bachelors or Advanced degree in a related field.
  • Experience with the Rithum for Brands (ChannelAdvisor) platform.
  • Intrapreneurial/founder mindset.
  • Experience with AI tooling for documentation, requirements gathering, and/or building solutions.
  • Integration-heavy environment exposure (APIs, webhooks).
  • Experience using tooling commonly associated with technical delivery and operations (JIRA, Notion, backlog tools, documentation tooling, and basic data analysis).

 

Travel Required

jobs.description:
About Us 
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 
 About the Role
 As Project Quality Manager, you own the Project & Program pillar of Harmattan’s Quality organization. You set the quality standards that carry every programme from first prototypes through to mass production. You lead the Project Quality Engineers and act as the quality counterpart of Program Management, Engineering and our institutional customers. Your work keeps quality gates rigorous at the right level for each development phase, in line with ISO 9001 / EN 9100.
 
 Responsibilities
 Leadership & Team Building 
 Lead, coach and grow the Project Quality Engineering team, and allocate engineers across active programmes.

 Act as the quality counterpart of Program Management, Engineering leads and institutional customers.

 Standardize project quality practices across programmes and turn lessons learned into company standards.

 Quality Gates & Product Development 
 Own quality gate governance from EVT to PVT and transfer to mass production, including go/no-go recommendations.

 Drive advanced product quality planning (APQP / EN 9145): quality plans, DFMEA / PFMEA, special characteristics and control plans.

 Ensure design and development quality per EN 9100: design reviews, verification and validation evidence, configuration and change control.

 Arbitrate open development non-conformities, risks and deviations, and lead structured problem solving.

 Customer Deliverables & Performance 
 Deliver customer quality documentation, including quality and management plans and qualification and acceptance files.

 Prepare customer audits and delivery verification readiness together with Site Quality.

 Align with Supplier Quality and Industrialization on first article inspection and production readiness.

 Define and report project quality KPIs, including risks, non-conformities and gate readiness, reviewed regularly with Programs.

 
 Candidate Requirements
 Engineering degree (MSc or equivalent) in quality, aeronautical, mechanical, electronics or systems engineering.

 8+ years in project, programme or design quality in aerospace, defense, automotive or high-tech hardware.

 2 to 3+ years leading a team, or leading quality on a full programme.

 Strong command of EN 9100 / ISO 9001, APQP / PPAP (EN 9145), DFMEA / PFMEA, control plans, design reviews and 8D.

 Experience taking complex electromechanical or embedded products through EVT / DVT / PVT to serial production.

 Structured and pragmatic, applying the right level of rigor per phase and holding firm at gates when needed.

 Knowledge of AQAP 2110 and defense customer requirements is a plus; comfort with Jira and Confluence.

 Regular on-site presence at the production site, alongside Paris-based work.

 Fluency in French and English required.

 
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Product Manager Soft Fabrics
jobs.description:
Hunter Douglas is wereldwijd marktleider in raamdecoratie en een toonaangevende producent van architecturale producten. Wij zijn een merk dat u kent en vertrouwt. Met meer dan 100 jaar ervaring in innovatie hebben wij onze industrie mede vormgegeven met unieke producten die baanbrekend design en functionaliteit combineren. Onze producten zijn wereldwijd te vinden in miljoenen woningen en commerciële gebouwen. Wij zijn op zoek naar gedreven, intelligente, creatieve en ondernemende mensen. Door uitdagende functies en versnelde groeimogelijkheden te bieden, gedreven door een gezamenlijke ambitie om succesvol te zijn, creëren wij een omgeving waarin uw carrière zich verder kan ontwikkelen.

In ruil voor uw expertise bieden wij een competitief en uitgebreid arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket, zodat u zich gewaardeerd voelt voor de bijdrage die u levert. Onze ambitie is om het snelst groeiende en meest geliefde raamdecoratiebedrijf ter wereld te worden. Wat is uw ambitie?

Product Manager Soft Fabrics

 

Wil jij bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van hoogwaardige stoffen die hun weg vinden naar klanten door heel Europa? Krijg je energie van de combinatie van productontwikkeling, commercie en projectmanagement? Dan is dit een mooie kans om als Product Manager Soft Fabrics onderdeel te worden van ons Product Team.

 

Jouw rol

Als Product Manager Soft Fabrics ben je verantwoordelijk voor het product en het commerciële succes van onze collecties voor gordijn- en meubelstoffen. Design is verantwoordelijk voor de creatieve ontwikkeling van de stoffen. Vanuit Product Management vertegenwoordig jij de markt-, klant- en businessbehoefte. Je brengt markt- en klantinzichten in en vertaalt deze naar duidelijke productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten. Vervolgens bewaak je samen met Design het ontwikkelproces en stuur je op een succesvolle productintroductie en optimale productlevenscyclus. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's van Sales, Marketing, Procurement, Supply Chain en het Design Team.

 

Je combineert projectmanagement met commercieel inzicht, data-analyse en een passie voor textiel. Een veelzijdige rol waarin je veel verschillende mensen en disciplines bij elkaar brengt.

 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je beheert het fabrics-portfolio gedurende de volledige productlevenscyclus, van concept tot uitfasering.
  • Samen met Design vertaal je marktinzichten naar productbriefings en commerciële uitgangspunten voor nieuwe stoffen en collecties.
  • Je coördineert productontwikkelingsprojecten van conceptfase tot marktintroductie, waarbij je samenwerkt met Design voor de ontwikkeling van nieuwe stoffen en collecties.
  • Je bewaakt planning, voortgang, risico's, budget en afstemming tussen de verschillende betrokken teams.
  • Je bent gedurende het ontwikkelproces een commerciële en strategische sparringpartner voor Design.
  • Je analyseert markt-, klant- en verkoopdata en vertaalt inzichten naar kansen voor het portfolio.
  • Je ondersteunt bij prijsstelling, productpositionering en businesscases.
  • Je werkt samen met Sales en Marketing aan productintroducties, trainingen en commerciële tools.
  • Je zorgt voor goede productinformatie en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor interne en externe stakeholders.

 

Dit breng jij mee

Je bent een junior/medior professional die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt en energie krijgt van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en projecten. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante ervaring in bijvoorbeeld productmanagement, projectmanagement, category management of een vergelijkbare functie.

 

Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een hbo diploma in bijvoorbeeld Bedrijfskunde, Marketing, Textieltechnologie of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Sterke projectmanagement- en stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden.
  • Commercieel inzicht en een klantgerichte instelling.
  • Een analytische, data-gedreven manier van werken.
  • Ervaring met het managen van meerdere projecten en stakeholders tegelijk.
  • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.
  • Interesse in AI en de mogelijkheden om hiermee productiviteit, inzichten en bedrijfsprocessen te verbeteren.
  • Ervaring binnen een productieomgeving, textiel, interieurproducten of een industriële omgeving is een pré.

 

Je bent georganiseerd, proactief en hands-on. Je houdt gemakkelijk overzicht, ook wanneer er verschillende belangen en deadlines spelen. Tegelijkertijd werk je graag samen en weet je anderen mee te krijgen in jouw aanpak.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager (F/H)
jobs.description:
At Younited, we believe credit and banking should feel as simple, fast and transparent as everything else in your digital life.

 So we build financial services that way. We combine technology, data and automation to rethink the way people borrow, pay, save and manage their money.

 
 Today, more than 1.5 million customers trust us, and nearly 500 employees contribute to our growth across 4 European countries .

 What we build 

 
 
 
 
 Younited Credit – instant consumer credit, directly accessible to customers.

 
 Younited Pay – instalment payment and financing solutions embedded into our partners' customer journeys.

 
 Younited Cashback – cashback and personalised offers, enhanced by open banking data.

 
 Younited Bank – our everyday banking offering, currently available through helios by Younited and being expanded.

 

 
 Our ambition is to build a financial partner people genuinely trust, combining simplicity, transparency and responsible finance. As a certified B Corp, we integrate social and environmental considerations into the way we build our business.

 

 The 5 values we work by 

 
 
 
 
 Make it simple - in the product, in the customer experience and in how we organise. Be transparent.

 
 Act as an entrepreneur - take ownership, play as a team, dare to try and accept failure.

 
 Innovate or die - challenge the status quo, however impossible it may seem.

 
 Faster is better - speed over perfection, alignment over debate.

 
 No limit - shoot for the moon, stay humble.

 

 
 We give passionate problem-solvers the space to do their best work in diverse and inclusive teams across Europe, because that is how we build better financial products for our customers and partners.
 

 
 Context 📄

 How do you turn complex credit and payment products into propositions that customers understand, partners value and teams can sell?

 As Product Marketing Manager at Younited, you will shape the insights, narratives and tools that help our products stand out and grow. You will work across Younited’s product portfolio, with Younited Pay as your initial priority given its strategic importance and the competitiveness of its market.

 Within Marketing Central, you will join the Customer Engagement team and work with Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams. Depending on business priorities, your scope may evolve across different Younited products, audiences and customer journeys.

 Your mission will be to understand the audiences we want to reach, clarify what makes our products valuable and turn market, customer and field feedback into concrete recommendations for Sales, Partnerships, Product and Marketing. You will connect market reality, commercial priorities and product decisions by turning research, customer insights and field feedback into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations. You will also work closely with the PRM/CRM teams to connect these insights with customer journeys, engagement and retention initiatives.

 Key responsibilities 🚀

 1) Build market and customer understanding 

 
 
 Conduct market research, competitive analysis and customer data analysis to identify target audiences, understand their needs, uncover opportunities and bring the voice of the customer into business and product decisions.

 
 Work across several products, audiences and business priorities, with Younited Pay as the initial priority.

 
 Work with the PRM/CRM and Customer Engagement teams on segmentation, use cases and customer journeys across acquisition, activation, repeat usage and retention, including merchant onboarding for Younited Pay and other priority journeys across the Younited portfolio.

 
 2) Define positioning and support commercial teams 

 
 
 Clarify the benefits, differentiators and key messages of Younited products, making complex topics compelling and easy to understand for customers, merchants, partners and internal teams.

 
 Turn market and customer insights into sales pitches, presentations, enablement materials, partner tools and practical recommendations that help Sales and Partnerships teams explain and sell our products.

 
 Contribute to strategic RFPs by understanding requirements and shaping the response narrative, value proposition, differentiators, proof points and presentation materials.

 
 3) Partner with Product teams and support product evolutions 

 
 
 Bring market feedback and customer insights into product discussions and roadmaps, and influence product decisions based on market and customer feedback.

 
 Support product launches and evolutions with the necessary materials, including demos, training materials, operational guides, FAQs and sales enablement documents.

 
 Work across Product, Sales, Partnerships, Data, Brand & Communications and local marketing teams to turn insights into clear messages, useful tools and actionable recommendations.

 

 About you 👇

 
 
 You have at least 5 years of experience

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager LogicSteel
Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
jobs.description:
The role 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale.

This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time.

The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time.

You’re welcome to work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback.
  • Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria.
  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality.
  • Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions.
  • Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in developer tools, API platforms, or search and retrieval infrastructure.
  • Track record of shipping products in fast-moving markets, working closely with engineering and design from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus.
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you can context-switch between strategic thinking and tactical execution without losing the thread.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 

  • Experience in search, information retrieval, NLP, or adjacent domains.
  • Background in API-first or developer-platform businesses with both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments.
  • People management or mentoring experience (building the skills of other PMs).

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

 Deep in the wording. Fast in the build. 

 About Insify 

 Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

 We're doing it differently.

 Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

 We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

 Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

 What you’ll own in your first year 
 You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

 
 Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.

 Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.

 Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.

 Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.

 Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

 
 Who you are 
 You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

 You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.

 You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be . Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.

 You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market , and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.

 You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.

 You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.

 You think like the customer : plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.

 You’re at home in Excel and data , and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.

 You work fluently in English ; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

 What we offer 

 Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.

 Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.

 A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.

 A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.

 Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.

 The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).

 The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

 If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us 
 At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.
 
 The role 
 Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.
 
 You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.
 
 You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.
 
 Key responsibilities 
 Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

 Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

 Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

 Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

 Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

 Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

 Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

 Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

 Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

 Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

 Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

 Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

 
 Your background 
 You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:
 A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

 Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

 Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

 A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

 A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

 Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

 
 You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦ 
 Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information,

jobs.title: Head of Strategy and Product
jobs.description:
About Act 
 There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. 
 Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.
  
 About the Role 
 You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.
 We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.
  
 What You Will Be Doing 
 Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

 Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

 Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

 Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

 Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

 Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

 Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

  
 What You Will Need 
 Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

 Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

 Comfortable working across different business functions.

 Strong ownership and execution skills.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

 Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

  
 How We Work 
 The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.
 We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.
 This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.
  
 Interview Process 
 If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.
 Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.
 We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels 
 Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 
 Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.
 Team mission 
 Travelers come to GetYourGuide with options in front of them, and they book when they’re confident they’ve found the right one. As a member of the Traveler Analytics leadership team, you’ll lead Comparison Analytics. You’ll define how we measure and improve the moment travelers choose between experiences: the activity page, the content and reviews behind it, how options and prices are presented, and what makes one experience stand out from another.
 This means answering hard product questions. What makes a traveler confident enough to book? Which content changes decisions, and how do we measure that when conversion alone misses part of the value? How do price and value presentation shape choice? You’ll partner with Product, Design, Engineering, and Content leaders to shape these decisions, while building the analytics foundation and the team that delivers the answers. We need someone who has built and led high-performing analytics teams, built the measurement a product area runs its decisions on, and shaped company strategy with data.
 Your toolkit 
 Proven leadership: You’ve hired, developed, and grown teams of analysts in fast-growth environments. You’ve coached analysts into senior ICs and leads, and you’re great at it.

 Strategic partnership: You’ve shaped company strategy and roadmaps, influenced resource allocation, and built measurement frameworks that change how businesses make decisions instead of only reporting on them.

 Hands-on technical fluency: You’re a hands-on leader who is proficient with SQL, experimentation design, causal inference, and metric definition. You can review a complex analysis, spot the flaw, and get into the data when needed. You don’t need to write every query, but you can, and you’ll use those skills to level up the team.

 Influence executives: You turn complex analyses into crisp recommendations. You know when to push back on ideas and when to say “we don’t know yet, but here’s how we’ll find out.

 Extras that give you an edge 
 Two-sided marketplace or e-commerce experience (preferred but not required)

 How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary

 Health and wellness benefits
