 Team mission 
 Landing pages are one of GetYourGuide's most important product surfaces — the moment where acquisition meets experience, and where the quality of what we build directly determines whether a visitor becomes a customer.
 Your mission 
 As Lead Product Manager for Landing Pages, you will own a high-traffic surface that sits at the intersection of growth, acquisition, and user experience. You will work closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure the pages you build perform across channels, while keeping the traveller's needs at the centre of every decision. Your cross-functional team includes engineers, designers, analysts, and researchers.
 This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, is energised by the product-marketing boundary, and wants to build something that scales — not just ship features. The work has direct visibility into how GetYourGuide grows, and the decisions made here have a measurable impact on the business from day one.
 We are looking for a Lead PM who brings both strategic clarity and executional rigour — someone who can set a vision, bring stakeholders along, and deliver.
 What You'll Do 
 Build modular, reusable infrastructure — page templates, content modules, and page logic — that compounds in value over time. You are not optimising individual features; you are building the foundation that makes everything that follows faster and cheaper.

 Develop and implement a strategy for your product area, set clear measurable goals, and take full responsibility for outcomes. Connect your roadmap to the company's mission, break it into actionable steps, and create genuine excitement for the long-term vision — with your team, across functions, and with executive leadership.

 Apply your understanding of acquisition channel economics and how landing page content drives channel performance. Partner closely with paid search, paid media, and SEO stakeholders to ensure pages serve channel needs without being built around any single one. Hold user experience and channel performance goals together rather than trading them off.

 Design and own an experimentation system at scale — not just individual A/B tests, but the architecture and cadence that enables rapid, parallel testing across page types and channels. Build toward a model that increases the speed and independence of experimentation over time.

 Use customer feedback, market trends, and business metrics to drive decisions. Prioritise ruthlessly, re-evaluate the roadmap as new insights arrive, and make clear calls on sequencing to maximise both impact and learning.

 Represent customer interests at all levels of the organisation. Act with openness and transparency with your team, peers, and leadership. Coach and mentor team members, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and bring others along on the vision.

 Your toolkit 
 6+ years of experience in product management , with a t least 2 years as a Lead or Senior PM owning a product area end-to-end — including strategy, goal-setting, roadmap execution, and KPI accountability.

 A systems thinker who builds for scale. You have experience building product infrastructure or platforms — not just features — and you understand how foundational work compounds over time.

 Experience working at the intersection of product and marketing, growth, or acquisition. You have a working understanding of how channels like paid search, paid social, or SEO use product surfaces to drive performance, and you're comfortable holding user experience and channel performance goals together.

 Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in experimentation — designing testing methodology and cadence, not just interpreting results. You know how to build a testing culture and move a team toward data-informed decisions at speed.

 Proven ability to build alignment across engineering, design, analytics, and marketing stakeholders. You bring people along through clear thinking and strong communication rather than through authority.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. You can translate complex product and technical concepts for executive, marketing, and engineering audiences equally well.

 Bonus: Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, or travel business.

 Bonus: A background in engineering or data science — particularly valuable given the technical architecture nature of this role.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, User Platform
jobs.description:
Change the way the world travels 
 Join the GetYourGuide journey to connect people with unforgettable travel experiences around the world. Millions look to us for unique activities they can trust, and it’s all powered by our commitment to make every single journey extraordinary - including yours. 
 Ready to unlock your potential with a community of fellow explorers? Find your next role at our Berlin HQ or one of our local offices around the globe, from New York to Bangkok. Head to getyourguide.careers to take the first step.
 Team mission 
 GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.
 Your mission 
 As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.
 The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.
 We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.
 What You'll Do 
 Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month vision and strategy for the traveler context domain, define how we win in it, and take full responsibility for the outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.

 Ambiguity: Operate in a domain that is being defined as you build it. Break an open-ended platform problem into a phased, coherent plan, and make confident calls with incomplete information.

 Prioritization: Choose the few use cases that prove the platform, and be explicit about what we will not build. Balance the depth a single consumer wants against the breadth the platform needs, and sequence to maximise learning.

 Collaboration: Build trust with consuming teams across Growth, Retention, Search, Care and Supply, and negotiate the line between what we own and what they own. Proactively manage the dependencies and handoffs that keep the strategy executable.

 Communication and adoption: Make the platform legible to the rest of the company, from engineers to executives. Create demand where none exists yet by showing teams what becomes possible, then convert that into committed adoption.

 Technical fluency: Set the technical bar for the team and work credibly with data scientists and engineers on identity resolution, feature and embedding design, and serving architecture. Bring a clear point of view on when a heuristic beats a model, and on build versus buy versus partner.

 Experimentation: Validate the layer with real consumers and real traffic. Design the tests that show a shared representation outperforms the local copies teams build today.

 Leadership: Represent the interests of our users and our internal consumers at every level of the organization. Act with openness and transparency with your team, your peers and executive leadership, and coach others on the craft of building platform products

 Your toolkit 
 6+ years of professional experience in product management, including at least 2 years at Lead level or with equivalent scope, and meaningful time spent on data, machine learning or platform products

 Demonstrated ownership of a product area whose users are other teams, such as an internal platform, an API or a data product, including strategy, KPI definition, goal setting and adoption, not only delivery

 Strong data literacy: comfortable querying and interpreting large datasets, designing experiments, and working day to day with data scientists and analysts

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit 
 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. 
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. 
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
  
 The Role 
 We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

 Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

 Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

 Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

 Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

 Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

 Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

 Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

 Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

 Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

 Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

 Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

 Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 
 The Kind of Builder We Want 
 Can set direction and still go deep into details.

 Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

 Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

 Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

 Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.

 
 This Role Is Not For 
 Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

 People who cannot go deep into product details.

 Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

 Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

 People who need large teams before they can create progress.

 
 Location 
 This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany .
  
 Language 
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
 Interview Process 
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 1. Online assessment or practical task
 2. Role-specific interview
 3. CEO / final round
  
 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Doit 
 We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. 
  
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. 
  
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. 
 
 The Role 
 Doit is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
  
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
  
 The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
  
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager (Senior to Staff)
jobs.description:
At DistroKid, we help artists share their music with the world. Around 40-50% of the world's new music is released through DistroKid today.

We're hiring a Growth Product Manager (Senior to Staff level) to help us achieve our big vision that everyone who makes music has a DistroKid account.

At DistroKid, our product and marketing funnels evolved in parallel. This role unites them and owns the whole picture: member growth end to end, from how artists find us through to how they get value and stay for the long haul. Within the goals leadership sets, you’ll establish where the leverage is, back it with data, and ship.

We're looking for someone who has done this before. You've owned growth at a high-growth consumer or subscription business, you've seen what works and what doesn't across the funnel, and you'll arrive with a point of view on what we should do. A big part of this role is bringing that experience with you and helping the rest of the company get better at growth.

You'll partner with our staff marketing engineer to direct a small, diligent cross-functional team, and work with them while working across product, marketing, data, and design. This role reports into product and treats marketing as an equal partner in setting priorities. You'll shape a single growth backlog, balancing measurable wins against the longer-term bets worth protecting. You'll build the framework that sizes every growth opportunity on the same terms, so prioritization performs on evidence and expected impact. Ideas and market intelligence come from across the company; you turn the greatest of them into instrumented experiments tied to the product roadmap.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own member growth, the growth strategy, and the prioritized backlog that moves it, and build the measurement framework the company uses to size and evaluate growth bets
  • Navigate the full funnel to achieve our growth goals, including acquisition, onboarding, activation, retention, reactivation, and referrals
  • Set the standard for how we run experiments end to end: hypothesis, instrumentation, analysis, iteration, and knowing when to stop
  • Use AI tooling to compress the loop from idea to shipped experiment, multiplying what a small, nimble team can ship
  • Keep the executive team clear on what you're doing, why, and what you're trading off
  • Bring what you've learned on the consumer growth teams you've worked on (and keep learning from the best ones), and adapt it to how artists find and use DistroKid
  • Raise the growth bar across the company, helping PMs and marketers surface and clear their own growth blockers
  • Use and iterate on the artist tools and promo assets we already have to build organic and viral growth loops.

What We're Looking For:

  • 7+ years in product, including 5+ years working directly in growth
  • 3+ years owning a growth number (paying members, conversion, retention, or self-serve revenue) and the metrics that drive it, at a high-growth consumer or subscription business
  • Experience across several parts of the funnel (acquisition, conversion, activation, engagement, retention and churn), not just one step
  • You’ve set growth strategy yourself. You found the opportunities, made the calls, and can point to the numbers that moved because of it
  • You conduct experiments at scale, pull your own data, and know the difference between a real result and noise
  • You've used AI tools to get real growth or productivity gains, not just experimented with them
  • You take rough, half-formed ideas from across the company and turn them into plans a team is excited to perform
  • You’ve seen enough consumer and subscription growth to arrive with informed views on where the opportunity is, and you change them when the data tells you to
  • You make complicated things simple and explain them well, including the trade-offs
  • It's a bonus (but not required) to have:
    • familiarity with lifecycle and martech tooling
    • experience designing and enhancing personalized surfaces (and a clear sense of when personalization earns its complexity and when it doesn't)

What You’ll Work With

  • A dedicated growth team including engineering, data, and design support
  • A reporting line into our Chief Product Officer, and marketing as a co-owner of the growth backlog
  • High traffic volume and a product millions of artists already love
  • A company that values speed, creativity, and clear thinking

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Developer Experience (DevEx)
jobs.description:
Our mission

 We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

 In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

 We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

 Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

 How you'll help us achieve it 

 Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder.

 AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works.

 The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will:

 
 Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers.

 Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact.

 Drive user research within our engineering and product teams.

 Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making.

 Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment.

 Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings.

 Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes.

 
 In this role, you'll... 

 
 Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.

 Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction. 

 Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.

 Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs.

 Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.

 Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely.

 Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar.

 
 Key Details 

 
 This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso

 Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy.

 Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.

 Major benefits:

 
 Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).

 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.

 Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 

 $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

 

 
 Requirements 

 
 Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you've shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function.

 Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation.

 Speak fluent English

 Bonus if you:
 
 Have proven experience with successfully rolling out AI-based solutions in a larger org

 Have professional experience in a consumer fintech company

Associate Product Manager - Stage de fin d'études Paris - Theodo AI-Mod
jobs.description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès 

 Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. 

 

 Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. 

 

 Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques. 
 

 

 La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. 

 

 Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! 
 

 Ton équipe : 

 Tu intègres une équipe projet composée de développeurs, de designers et d'un Lead Product Manager. 

 Leur rôle : concevoir des produits de qualité, les livrer dans les temps, avec un excellent niveau de service. 

 

 Ton objectif en tant qu'Associate Product Manager est d’aider l’équipe à maximiser la valeur du produit en priorisant et livrant des fonctionnalités de qualité à ton client. 

 

 Tes futures missions : 

 - Piloter le delivery en appliquant la méthodologie Lean : prioriser les features, rédiger des user stories claires et s’assurer de respecter les jalons pour délivrer dans les temps. 

 

 - Collaborer avec ton client pour comprendre ses besoins, challenger ses idées et co-construire des solutions digitales à forte valeur ajoutée. 

 

 Tes perspectives d’évolutions : 

 Chez Theodo, on recherche des personnes qui ont envie d’apprendre et de progresser. Plusieurs career paths sont possibles au sein de ton entité ou du groupe. En fonction de tes appétences, tu pourras évoluer vers différents rôles (Product Manager, Lead Product Manager…). 

 

 Profil recherché : 

 - Tu es diplômé(e) d'une grande école d'ingénieur 

 - Tu souhaites participer à la conception de produits à fort impact business 

 - Tu as un excellent relationnel et sera à l’aise en face de nos clients 

 - Tu es passionné par la tech, et tu as de bonnes connaissances sur ce sujet 

 - Tu as une énorme envie d’apprendre, de challenger et d’être challengé(e) pour progresser 

 

 Process de recrutement : 

 - 1er appel avec un recruteur (30min) 

 - Entretien Fit Culturel (1h) 

 - Entretien tech & produit (1h) 

 - Entretien dirigeant (30min) 
 
 Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ?

 Contrat : CDI
 À noter : ce poste est basé en France. Vous devez donc y résider ou être prêt·e à déménager, et disposer déjà du droit de travailler dans l’UE. Nous ne pouvons pas proposer de sponsoring de visa, mais nous l’examinons poste par poste : gardez un œil sur notre site carrières pour les opportunités à venir. 
 Un français et un anglais courants (à l’oral comme à l’écrit) sont indispensables, et nous vous demandons de soumettre votre CV en anglais . À propos de Kaluza 
 Kaluza est la plateforme d’Energy Intelligence qui transforme la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.
 Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel à travers les foyers, les appareils, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie quotidienne.
 Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.
 Ce que vous ferez : 
 Vous serez responsable de la localisation française de Device Data Management (DDM), l’un des domaines produit clés de la plateforme Kaluza. DDM consomme des flux de données internes et externes pour représenter les fournitures, compteurs, registres, relevés et consommations. Il gère aussi les parcours liés à ces entités (par exemple, la mise à jour de la configuration d’un compteur), les API qui exposent les données, les pages front-end qui les présentent aux utilisateurs, ainsi que les calculs de projection et d’extrapolation de consommation. C’est un rôle produit full-stack et très opérationnel : vous interviendrez sur tout le domaine, du modèle de données jusqu’à ce que voient les utilisateurs à l’écran.
 Traduire les exigences du marché français en spécifications claires : transformer les règles du marché de l’énergie français (Enedis, GRDF, passerelle GRD, règles sur les données de compteurs et d’équipements) en exigences produit détaillées couvrant la conformité réglementaire, les flux de données des équipements et la qualité des données.

 Travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos clients : collaborer main dans la main avec ENGIE et les futurs clients du marché français pour comprendre leurs besoins et construire les exigences ensemble. Bâtir une relation de confiance telle qu’ils viennent vous voir en premier, et vous appuyer sur cette proximité pour orienter ce que DDM construira ensuite pour la France.

 Construire, pas seulement spécifier : passer vous-même de l’idée au prototype fonctionnel en interrogeant les données, en esquissant des contrats d’API et en montant des preuves de concept. Nous attendons de vous que vous utilisiez quotidiennement des outils d’IA (ex. Claude Code) comme multiplicateur pour prototyper, investiguer et débloquer des situations, et pas seulement pour rédiger des documents.

 Aligner les équipes globales et locales, toutes fonctions confondues : travailler étroitement avec l’ingénierie, l’UX, la QA et bien d’autres, avec une influence full-stack, pour que tout le monde vise les bons résultats.

 Être la personne de référence pour DDM France : faire le lien entre nos équipes globales et locales afin d’éclairer les priorités et la stratégie.

 Ce que vous apportez : 
 Critères essentiels :
 Une expérience avérée en tant que Product Manager, Business Analyst ou équivalent dans des éditeurs de logiciels, avec un solide historique de localisation réussie de produits logiciels complexes pour des marchés internationaux

 Un français courant et une grande aisance en anglais : notre plateforme et beaucoup de nos équipes fonctionnent en anglais, vous passez donc facilement de l’un à l’autre

 De l’aisance dans le travail direct avec les clients : vous savez animer une session de travail avec des interlocuteurs clients, faire émerger le vrai besoin derrière la demande, et garder les décideurs alignés et impliqués

 Un état d’esprit de bâtisseur et une aisance technique : débrouillard·e et opérationnel·le, vous préférez construire un prototype fonctionnel plutôt qu’attendre la spécification parfaite. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les modèles de données, les bases de données et les API, et vous pouvez tenir une conversation technique. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur·e, mais vous raisonnez comme tel·le, et vous êtes aussi à l’aise pour réfléchir à un modèle de données que pour penser à ce que l’utilisateur voit à l’écran

 Une communication claire et incisive, capable de faire le tri dans le bruit et d’expliquer la complexité tec

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 The opportunity 
 Our engineering teams build a product that enterprises run their purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes on every day. Much of the product knowledge behind it sits with our founders and domain experts. As we grow, we are moving from a project-oriented model, where features come top-down and success is measured by output, to a product-oriented one: empowered teams that own problems end-to-end and are measured by their impact on customers and the business.
 As Head of Product, you lead that shift. You build the product management practice for the BLP Platform from an early stage. Our first product managers are joining stream-aligned teams, starting with Invoice and Procurement, and the team will grow to 4–5 PMs as we expand. You hire them, coach them, and set the standard for what great product work looks like at BLP.
 You report to the CTO and work closely with Engineering, Projects, Sales, and our founders.
 What you’ll do 
 Build and lead the product management practice for the BLP Platform: hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers as we scale.

 Move the product organization from an output-driven model to an outcome-driven one.

 Establish the product management craft at BLP: discovery practices, evidence-based decision making, and a clear standard for what “good” looks like in the role.

 Transfer product knowledge out of the experts’ heads and into the teams, without losing the domain depth that got us here.

 Build the direct line between our teams and our customers.

 Make our data usable for product decisions. We have BigQuery, PostHog, and prediction-rate analytics available, and we want product managers who reach for them by default.

 Shape how the product organization works as we grow: intake, prioritization, roadmapping, and the operating rhythm.

 Contribute directly to product strategy for the platform.

 What you bring 
 10+ years in product management, including experience leading or formally coaching product managers, with a real point of view on how product people are developed.

 Experience working in an empowered product model, where teams were assigned problems to solve rather than features to build.

 A track record of shipping enterprise B2B software that customers actually adopted.

 Experience moving an organization toward an empowered product model, including the political and cultural side of it.

 The ability to hold a position with engineers, sales, and executives, and to say no in a way that keeps the relationship.

 Entrepreneurial judgment: comfortable operating with incomplete information, choosing a direction, and owning the result.

 Fluent English.

 Enterprise ERP or finance exposure, experience with AI or agentic products in production (particularly reliability, evaluation, and trust in enterprise settings), and German are a plus.

 Why BLP 
 Build a function: you shape how product management works at BLP while the team grows.

 Direct work with the CTO and founders on product strategy for the platform.

 A product with deep domain substance and a large enterprise customer base to learn from.

 Employee participation plan.

 How we work 
 Impact: We create measurable business outcomes.

 Transparency: We build trust through openness.

 Ownership: We take responsibility for outcomes.

 Excellence: We relentlessly strive for greatness.

 Practical information 
 Location: hybrid from our Zurich, London, Munich or Cologne offices, or remote elsewhere in Europe.

 Employment: full-time, permanent.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager Financial Services (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Omnium ist die hybride Finanzberatungsplattform von G+D Netcetera für Schweizer Banken und Versicherungen. Die Lösung verbindet persönliche Beratung mit digitalen Werkzeugen und unterstützt Finanzinstitute dabei, ihre Kund:innen über alle Kanäle hinweg konsistent zu begleiten. So entstehen moderne Beratungserlebnisse und effiziente Prozesse für unsere Kunden.
 Für unseren Bereich Financial Advisory suchen wir eine erfahrene Projektmanagement-Persönlichkeit, die anspruchsvolle Digitalisierungsprojekte rund um Omnium von der Planung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss steuert. Du verbindest Kund:innenbedürfnisse, fachliche Anforderungen und technische Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Lösungen verlässlich, transparent und mit nachhaltigem Mehrwert realisiert werden.
 Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Kund:innen, dem Produktmanagement, der Produktentwicklung und der technischen Integration zusammen. Du schaffst Klarheit über Ziele, Verantwortlichkeiten und Abhängigkeiten und führst interdisziplinäre Teams sicher durch alle Projektphasen.
 Requirements 
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Du planst und realisierst Projekte zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Omnichannel-Beratungslösung Omnium und integrierst diese in die Systemlandschaften unserer Kund:innen
 Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für Qualität, Liefertermine, Ressourcen und Kosten
 Du berichtest transparent über Projektfortschritt und Risiken und leitest frühzeitig geeignete Massnahmen ein
 Du konzipierst und moderierst fachliche sowie technische Workshops
 Du führst interdisziplinäre Projektteams mit agilen oder hybriden Projektmanagement-Methoden
 Du koordinierst Produktmanagement, Produktentwicklung und technische Integration von der Konzeption bis zum offiziellen Projektabschluss
 Du stellst die strukturierte Übergabe in den Betrieb sicher und begleitest den Kunden auch nach der Einführung. Sei es im Ticketing, Releases und in der Zusammenarbeit mit der IT-Betriebsorganisation
 Dein Profil 
 Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Software- oder Digitalisierungsprojekte, idealerweise bei Banken, Versicherungen oder anderen regulierten Finanzinstituten
 Du fühlst dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT, Produktentwicklung und Delivery im Kundenumfeld sicher
 Du beherrschst Projektgovernance, Budget- und Ressourcenplanung sowie Risiko- und Stakeholdermanagement
 Du arbeitest routiniert mit agilen oder hybriden Vorgehensmodellen sowie Jira und Confluence
 Du verfügst über eine höhere Fachausbildung oder ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
 Du überzeugst mit planerischem und lösungsorientiertem Denken, einer strukturierten Arbeitsweise, sicherem Auftreten sowie sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen. Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
 Was dich bei uns erwartet 
 Du triffst auf ein Umfeld, in dem Expertise in Finanzdienstleistungen, Technologie und Beratung zusammenkommt. Wir arbeiten partnerschaftlich, unkompliziert und auf Augenhöhe, mit unseren Kund:innen genauso wie innerhalb des Teams. Eigeninitiative und unternehmerisches Denken sind bei uns ausdrücklich erwünscht. Wissen wird geteilt und gemeinsam suchen wir nach der besten Lösung.
 Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der erfolgreichen Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von Omnium. Mit deiner Projektführung prägst du nicht nur die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kund:innen, sondern auch unsere Delivery-Prozesse und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Projektmanagement-Standards.
 Wenn du komplexe Vorhaben gerne strukturierst, Menschen und Themen zusammenbringst und Projekte mit klarem Blick für Kundennutzen und Umsetzungserfolg zum Ziel führst, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
 
 Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.
 Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.
 About Us
 Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.
 Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.
 The Role
 You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.
 Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.
 We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.
 What You'll Do
 Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
 Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
 Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
 Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
 Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
 Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.
 Hiring Process
 Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
 15-minute phone screen
 First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
 Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
 Culture fit (45 min)
 We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.
 Requirements 
 You Should Have
 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
 Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
 An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
 You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
 Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.

jobs.title: Product Support & Enablement Lead
jobs.description:
About Mistral 
 Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
 We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
 
 About the role 
 We are looking for a Product Support & Enablement Lead to lead and develop our existing L1 Product Support team. You will help the team resolve more customer issues without escalating to L2, while improving the tools, training, and workflows that allow support to scale.

jobs.title: Product Owner (m|w|d)
jobs.description:
Deine Rolle bei uns

 Als Product Owner übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Fachbereich, Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteam. Du arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Geschäftsprozesse ein, strukturierst fachliche Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass daraus tragfähige, nutzerorientierte und wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Softwarelösungen entstehen.
Dabei behältst du Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, technische Abhängigkeiten und Projektziele im Blick, setzt klare Prioritäten und schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis zwischen Business und Entwicklung.
 Hör dir unseren Podcast Product Owner:innen im Alltag an! 

 Aufgaben

 
 Du analysierst, strukturierst und spezifizierst fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.

 Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, identifizierst die zugrunde liegenden Nutzer- und Geschäftsprobleme und leitest daraus passende Lösungsoptionen ab.

 Du priorisierst und pflegst das Product Backlog unter Berücksichtigung von Nutzen, Scope, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.

 Du übersetzt komplexe fachliche Anforderungen in verständliche und umsetzbare Aufgaben, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien für das Entwicklungsteam.

 Du moderierst Workshops und Abstimmungen mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung, UX/UI, Architektur und weiteren Stakeholdern.

 Du sorgst für Transparenz bei Anforderungen, Prioritäten und fachlichen Zielen und beziehst relevantes Nutzer- und Stakeholderfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung ein.

 Du begleitest Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und fachliche Abnahmen.

 Du bereitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor, kommunizierst Zielkonflikte transparent und erkennst Risiken sowie Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig.

 
 Qualifikation

 
 Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Digitalisierungsumfeld.

 Du kannst komplexe fachliche Anforderungen analysieren, strukturieren und adressatengerecht aufbereiten.

 Du bewertest Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und leitest daraus fundierte Prioritäten und Entscheidungen ab.

 Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen fachlichen und technischen Umfeldern und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Geschäftsprozesse ein.

 Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung mit und vermittelst souverän zwischen Fachbereich und Entwicklung.

 Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, verstehst Nutzerbedürfnisse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und entwickelst auch bei unterschiedlichen Interessen tragfähige Lösungen.

 Du hast Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen sowie idealerweise mit Jira und Confluence.

 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und mit einem hohen Maß an Selbstorganisation.

 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau).

 
 Benefits

 
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten

 Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten inkl. Übernahme von Weiterbildungskosten

 Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

 Individuelle Entfaltung und ein respektvolles Miteinander

 Offene Unternehmenskultur, angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre & regelmäßige Teamevents

 Langfristige Perspektiven, betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Krankenversicherung

jobs.title: Project Manager UK (Operations) - (all genders)
jobs.company: ubitricity - Gesellschaft für verteilte Energiesysteme mbH
jobs.description:
Your Mission

 Help build the UK's EV charging network

 At ubitricity, we're making EV charging simple, accessible and available where people need it most. As a Project Manager within our Operations Team, you'll play a key role in turning installation plans into operational charging infrastructure used by thousands of drivers every day.
You'll coordinate multiple installation projects from planning through to commissioning, working closely with contractors, local authorities, suppliers and internal stakeholders. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems, building relationships and delivering projects that have a visible impact on the UK's transition to electric mobility.
If you're highly organised, proactive and excited by infrastructure projects in a fast-growing industry, we'd love to hear from you. 

 What You'll Do

 
 Manage a portfolio of EV charging installation projects from initiation through to successful delivery and commissioning

 Coordinate contractors, suppliers and delivery partners to ensure projects are completed safely, on time and to the required quality standards

 Develop and maintain project plans, timelines and resource requirements

 Monitor project risks, dependencies and issues, implementing mitigation plans where required

 Prepare clear project updates, reports and progress tracking for internal and external stakeholders

 Ensure project documentation is accurate, complete and compliant with company processes

 Support budget tracking and gain exposure to project financial management

 Build strong relationships with local authorities, contractors and cross-functional teams

 Identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies

 Contribute to the continuous expansion of one of the UK's largest public EV charging networks

 
 Your profile

 What You'll Bring

 
 Experience supporting or delivering technical, infrastructure, construction or installation projects

 Confidence coordinating multiple stakeholders, including contractors, suppliers or field teams

 Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities

 A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail

 Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team

 Interest in sustainability, infrastructure and the energy transition

 
 Nice to Have

 
 Experience within EV charging, utilities, electrical infrastructure or public-sector projects

 Understanding of project budgeting and commercial management

 Familiarity with project management methodologies and tools

 Knowledge of highway electrical works or local authority delivery environments

 
 Your Background

 
 Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience

 Project management qualifications such as PRINCE2, APM or Agile certifications are advantageous but not essential

 
 Our Offer

 Why Join Us?

 At ubitricity, we're helping accelerate the transition to electric mobility by delivering innovative EV charging solutions across the UK and Europe. As part of the Shell Group, we combine the agility of a growing technology business with the scale, stability and opportunities of a global organisation.
You'll join an international and collaborative team where your ideas matter, your development is supported and your work contributes directly to creating a more sustainable future. 

 Location & Ways of Working

 Location

We operate a hybrid working model and believe collaboration is strongest when people spend time together. Employees are expected to work from the office a minimum of three days per week , including our dedicated Face-to-Face Tuesday , designed to encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation.

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in London on a hybrid basis.

Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

As the Senior Product Manager, you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.

  • Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs
  • Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences
  • Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales
  • Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies
  • Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation
  • Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements
  • Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting
  • Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.

What We're Looking For

  • Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game
  • Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development
  • Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision
  • Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels
  • Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that!  We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explo

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 
 
We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.
 
Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 
 
For more information, visit WPP.com.
 

 

WHO WE ARE

About Data & Technology Solutions

WPP’s Data & Technology Solutions is the WPP’s unified global data products and technology team. We work with our agencies and clients to build data data-driven solutions and technology product to power marketing transformation.

WPP Open is our AI platform for marketing, it connects marketing professionals, data, tools and AI in a single place. WPP Open is the simplest, safest and fastest way to realize the benefits of scaled AI – delivering better-informed creative ideas faster, at scale and at lower cost.

We’re endlessly curious and our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 2,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

 

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking an enthusiastic and analytical Product Owner with a passion for leveraging data to build impactful products. In this role, you will support the product development lifecycle for our data-driven marketing solutions, including the WPP Open platform. You'll be instrumental in translating user needs and data insights into clear product requirements, ensuring our solutions are innovative, valuable, and technically sound. Your strong understanding of data and SQL will be key to communicating effectively with engineering and data science teams and making informed product decisions.

You are:

  • Data-curious, with a proven ability to analyze information and derive actionable insights.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented, capable of breaking down complex problems and defining clear product needs.
  • An excellent communicator, able to bridge the gap between technical and business stakeholders.
  • A proactive learner, eager to deepen your understanding of AdTech, product management, and data-driven methodologies.
  • Collaborative, thriving in a cross-functional team environment and contributing to a shared vision.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Support Product Development & Lifecycle Management
  • Assist in defining, documenting, and prioritizing product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria based on user needs, business goals, and data analysis.
  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, Data Scientists, and UX Designers to ensure a shared understanding of product features and their underlying data implications.
  • Help manage and refine product backlogs, participate in agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews), and support release cycles.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and market research to identify opportunities and stay informed about industry trends in data and AI for marketing.

 

Leverage Data for Product Insights and Validation

  • Utilize SQL and other data analysis tools to query datasets, analyze product performance, identify trends, and generate insights that inform product strategy and prioritization.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to understand data availability, schemas, quality, and potential for new product features or enhancements.
  • Define and track key product performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics, helping to evaluate the success of new features post-launch.

 The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
  
 Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
  
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
 The Role 
 BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.
  
 This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges. 
  
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

 Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

 Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

 Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

 Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

 Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

 Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

 Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

 Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

 Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

 AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

jobs.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. 

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! 
 What You'll Own 
 The website, GEO, and the acquisition funnel, for the Career Professionals (individual, B2P) and Self Serve Employers (under 250 employees, under roughly $20,000 a year, no salesperson) segments specifically.

 Self-serve conversion, from first visit through signup, upgrade, and, eventually, the point where an account outgrows self-serve and hands off to the Assisted tier.

 The B2P and SMB messaging, in practice, not just in the shared Messaging Framework, this is the one seat that gets to see directly whether that messaging actually converts.

 
 What Success Looks Like 
 A defensible, evidence-backed answer to the LTV:CAC question this seat's own existence is gated on.

 A written, documented Critical User Journey for the self-serve signup and upgrade path, which currently doesn't exist anywhere in the registry, despite being arguably the easiest journey in the company to document precisely, since nobody has to be interviewed to understand it.

 Growth in self-serve revenue that either justifies this becoming a permanent Senior PM seat, or, just as validly, a clear, honest case that it shouldn't.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Real self-serve growth experience.Funnel optimization, conversion, GEO, and a track record of moving a number without a sales team's help.

 Comfort being precise about what the product actually does.The current messaging pillar "one system, individual to enterprise" is accurate for the core learner product but not for Command, since Self Serve Employers get no Command at all. You'll need to hold that distinction in your own funnel copy rather than overclaim it.

 A bias toward writing things down.This seat starts with more open whitespace, no CUJ, no dedicated pod, than almost any other seat in the org, and the person who takes it will be building the paper trail as much as the funnel.

 At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow. 

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT 
 Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
 We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.
 
 YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT 
 As a Senior AI Product Manager, you move plancraft closer to becoming the autopilot for the trades : Evolving our product from software that helps tradespeople manage their work into one where AI agents can take on meaningful parts of their daily workload.
 This is not about adding AI features to an existing roadmap. You’ll own an emerging problem space and identify where agents can create the highest leverage for our customers beyond what Plancraft does today. That means getting close to tradespeople and their businesses, uncovering the problems worth solving, and working with Engineering and UX to turn them into reliable, trustworthy products customers are willing to rely on for real work.
 You’ll operate across the full product journey: from spending time with tradespeople in the field and deciding which opportunity to pursue, to working with Engineering to understand technical requirements and trade-offs, defining evaluation criteria, shipping to production, and learning from real-world usage.
 The impact should be tangible. The products you build will aim to help trades businesses improve outcomes such as profit margins, quote acceptance rates, and capacity utilisation — while opening up entirely new product and growth opportunities for plancraft.
 
 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Own the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Plancraft’s customer-facing AI agents and workflows.

 Identify high-potential customer problems beyond today’s platform and translate messy, real-world trades workflows into focused opportunities for agentic products.

 Define and own the single co-worker interface for customers to interact with and manage agents and their underlying workflows.

 Work in a Product Trio with Engineering and UX throughout discovery, evaluation, and delivery, from early problem validation to production-quality releases.

 Establish a repeatable AI product operating loop across discovery, evaluation, release gates, monitoring, and iteration.

 Define and maintain evaluation sets, quality standards, and release criteria for customer-facing AI products, including accuracy, correction rates, latency, and safe rollback conditions.

 Instrument and monitor AI product performance, using customer behaviour and quality signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.

 Demonstrate measurable customer outcomes from AI-powered workflows, including improvements in efficiency, profitability, quote acceptance, capacity utilisation, activation, and retention.

 Contribute the Product perspective to technical and platform trade-offs, including customer value, quality, cost, and time to market, together with Engineering and the shared AI infrastructure counterpart.

 Partner across Product and Engineering to manage dependencies, reusable AI experience patterns, mobile and voice input, and handovers between customer workflows.

 Work closely with RevOps, Sales, and Customer Success to understand adoption and willingness-to-pay signals and contribute to AI pricing and monetisation experiments.

 
 Must-Have Skills 
 7+ years of product management experience , including at least 2 years owning and shipping AI products in production end-to-end.

 Strong applied GenAI literacy across LLMs, agents, RAG, and evaluation frameworks — sufficient to understand technical requirements and help evaluate Product, quality, cost, and time-to-market trade-offs together with Engineering.

 Experience building 0-to-1 AI products or new product areas , from customer discovery and problem definition through production launch and iteration.

 Experience defining quality and success criteria for AI products , including evaluation metrics, release thresholds, customer outcomes, and post-launch monitoring.

 Strong customer discovery and product judgment , with the ability to turn complex real-world workflows into focused AI product opportunities.

 Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment , with a track record of creating structure, setting priorities, and delivering despite ambiguity.

jobs.description:
The company 
 Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.
 That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.
 We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

 We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager 
 Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument.
 
 The team 
 The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else.  The role 
 This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate.
 The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.
