jobs.title: Staff Product Manager (Runtime Team)
jobs.description:
PolyAI is the Agentic Dialog Platform for building the conversational enterprise, used to build, run, govern, and improve dialog agents at scale. Powered by Raven, a proprietary dialog model trained on more than a billion enterprise conversations, PolyAI agents are built for complexity, open at every layer, and sovereign by design. PolyAI serves hundreds of enterprises across 75 languages and 25 countries, including Metro Bank, Marriott, PG&E, and UniCredit.

PolyAI automates customer service through lifelike voice assistants that let customers lead a conversation. Our voice assistants make it possible for businesses to deliver outstanding customer service that rivals their human agents.

Our customers, which include the world’s leading logos, are expanding how they use our platform, driving automation of critical customer service operations and integrating PolyAI into their daily customer service workflows.

We’re looking for a highly technical, senior product leader to own the platform underneath everything our agents do: the runtime that serves conversations in production, the inference layer that powers our models, and the data infrastructure that feeds both. This is a deep infrastructure role with direct exposure to latency, cost, and reliability tradeoffs at scale, not a roadmap-and-backlog role. You’ll set strategy for areas other teams build on top of, working closely with engineering leadership rather than through them

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the product strategy for runtime (how conversations get served in production), inference (how our models are hosted and served, including self-hosted and third-party paths), and the data platform (how conversation and model data moves, is stored, and is queried across the business)
  • Set direction on build-vs-buy and self-host-vs-managed tradeoffs for model serving, including evaluating cost, latency, and scaling implications of infrastructure decisions before they’re made, not after
  • Build and own the evaluation framework for how we measure runtime and inference performance in production (latency, throughput, cost per minute/token, failure rates), and drive continuous improvement off that data
  • Partner directly with infrastructure and platform engineering leadership to sequence a technical roadmap that often has no visible customer-facing surface, and defend its priority against features that do
  • Own how conversation data flows into and out of the platform, including data residency, retention, and access-control tradeoffs that affect what the business can build or sell
  • Translate ambiguous technical constraints (capacity limits, model failure modes, data gaps) into decisions the rest of the business can plan around
  • Lead and influence a cross-functional group of engineers, data scientists, and infrastructure specialists without formal authority over them
  • Represent this area in exec-level conversations on cost, capacity planning, and platform risk

jobs.title: Manager/Associate Director - Project Management
jobs.description:
About Relation 
 Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure.
 We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact.
 We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age.
 By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients.
 
 The opportunity 
 Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to work in close partnership with our Programme and Project Leaders, putting you in a prime position to help shape delivery plans and drive our osteoporosis programme forward.
 Working across the full discovery journey, you'll help move the programme through Target ID, Hit-to-Lead, Lead Optimisation, Candidate Selection and beyond — coordinating across the multiple projects that make up the programme, our internal interdisciplinary teams, and third-party partners such as CROs, all while navigating the ambiguity of discovery-stage science with confidence.
 You'll operate at programme level, with visibility across every project within the osteoporosis programme, partnering with the Programme Leader and the Project Leaders who own each individual project. If this sounds like you, and you thrive in matrixed environments and want a real hand in shaping how tomorrow's medicines are discovered, come and join us in the heart of London.
 
 Day to day, you will 
 Partner with Programme, Project Leaders and sponsors to understand the strategic objectives and delivery requirements across the programme.

 Orchestrate the matrix team to deliver against project objectives, motivating all team members with clear direction and communication.

 Work with functional leads to ensure appropriate resource allocation and to onboard supplementary resources where needed to support delivery.

 Proactively manage plans, budgets, risks and issues across the programme, escalating to senior management when appropriate.

 Support leadership in navigating high-impact, high-risk situations with clear analysis, high transparency and a spirit of partnership — even in the face of significant adversity or major obstacles.

 Translate scientific and strategic objectives into integrated project plans, timelines and milestones.

 Coordinate execution across the wet lab, ML research, data science and engineering teams, owning cross-team dependencies and prioritisation, and actively monitoring interdependencies across teams as the programme evolves.

 Identify and manage risks across the programme, working with team leads to mitigate blockers before they affect delivery.

 Coordinate joint governance bodies (steering committees, working groups, technical committees) — agendas, materials, minutes and follow-ups — and ensure decisions are documented and actioned.

 Communicate status clearly to internal leadership and external partners, surfacing decisions and trade-offs as they arise.

User Platform builds the identity and access capabilities that help people use Spotify safely and easily. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to shape how people access Spotify and stay connected across our apps, devices, and strategic partner integrations. You’ll focus on session management - how Spotify recognizes someone after they sign in, maintains their access, and enables them to connect or disconnect devices and applications.

 
You’ll bring together consumer experience and technical product strategy, working closely with engineering, design, research, insights, security, and teams responsible for Spotify’s clients and partnerships.  Improve how sessions are established, maintained, and ended, balancing reliable access with account protection, privacy, and user control.

 Shape device connection, session transfer, and partner authorization experiences, including clear consent when an app requests access or additional capabilities.

 Partner with engineering to make session and access capabilities reusable and easier to adopt through APIs, client components, documentation, and clear integration guidance.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI Team
jobs.description:
About us 
 Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.
 Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.
 
 About the role 
 As the Senior Product Manager on our AI team, you'll own how AI shows up in Tebi, from an AI agent embedded in the product to the AI capabilities that run through the platform. Tebi sits on a unified foundation of sales, payments, reservations, kitchen and inventory data, which gives our AI something most restaurant software can't offer: the full picture. You'll own the vision, strategy and roadmap, and turn that data into agents and features that save merchants time, cut costs and help them make better decisions on a busy service.
 
 What you’ll do: 
 Define and own the vision and roadmap for Tebi's AI agent and AI capabilities across the product.

 Work with AI engineers and data teams to ship agentic features that take real actions for merchants, not just answer questions.

 Spend time with restaurant owners, managers and staff, plus Sales and Customer Success, to find the jobs where AI genuinely removes friction in their day.

 Define how we measure quality and trust in AI features, including evals, accuracy, adoption and merchant outcomes, and use that to iterate quickly.

 Decide where AI belongs in the product and where it doesn't, including guardrails, human-in-the-loop moments and when the merchant makes the final call.

 Partner with all the other product teams so AI feels native to Tebi rather than bolted on.

 
 What you'll need: 
 8+ years of product management experience at a fast-growing tech company, with a track record of shipping impactful launches.

 You are highly collaborative, able to partner effectively across the organization and build trust with both technical and operational teams.

 Hands-on experience building AI-powered products and a solid grasp of their strengths and limits.

 A data-driven mindset: you combine quantitative signals and qualitative feedback, and you know how to evaluate non-deterministic products.

 You care about the balance between craft, speed, and outcomes.

 This probably isn't the role for you if you're happiest on a structured environment with clear directions. We are looking for someone to set the direction and the vision for this team.
 People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers .
 
 Benefits: 
 Generous start-up equity

 Competitive Salary

 Lunch provided in the office

 Team building events

 Unlimited time off

 
 What is Restaurant Software? 
Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don't. It's a mess, and we are fixing it.
 From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it's a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.
 How We Use AI at Tebi 
We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.
 At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn't make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

jobs.title: Chef.fe de Projet numérique en santé / Project Manager Healthtech
jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.
 Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.
 Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.
 
 
 ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations 
 L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.
 En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.
 
 
 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous 
 Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

 Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement.

 Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

 Coordonner Business Development, Ops Manager et R&D.

 Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

 Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

 Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

 Must-have
 Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

 Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

 Des bases en interopérabilité et en flux de données.

 La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

 Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

 Nice-to-have
 Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

 Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

 L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

 Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

 Soft skills
 Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.
 
 
 Nos valeurs
 Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.

 Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé.

 Position: Senior Product Manager
 Location: Zürich, on-site
 Job Type: Permanent, full-time 
 Start Date: As soon as possible
 Language: English (German is a plus)

 About Us 
 We are an early-stage startup that builds the future of how individuals and healthcare providers will interact with health related data. Our vision is to make complex medical data accessible, understandable and actionable for everyone through responsible use of AI. One of our products is a consumer mobile application that integrates with our health partners and is based on our intelligent data platform. To drive its further development, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Product Manager.
 
 The Role 

You will be responsible for shaping the product vision and roadmap with the team, creating an experience that patients and physicians find immediately valuable. Partnering closely with the engineering and business teams, you will translate complex AI functionality into a trusted, globally scalable product that grows through our partners and its own value.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop an inspiring product vision that aligns with the broader startup strategy and creates meaningful value for patients and healthcare professionals and partners

 Define a roadmap focused on immediate "time-to-value" and features that amaze its users.

 Identify and deeply understand the needs, pain points, and user journeys of patients and healthcare professionals to design compelling and engaging user interface mocks.

 Engineer partner- and product-led growth mechanics for instant onboarding and shareable moments.

 Balance the fast iteration of a consumer app with the safety and quality required for medical software, consider privacy by design.

 Lead cross-functionally, measuring success by user delight, growth and retention.

 
 What You Bring 
 5+ years in Product Management, ideally in high-growth startups.

 Hands-on experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).

 Proven experience engaging directly with customers and users to understand their needs, validate ideas, and co-create product solutions that deliver value

 AI-native expertise: you know how to embed AI into the product and your own workflow.

 Experience with design tools and/or rapid prototype software, e.g., Figma, Lovable, Claude Code, to effectively convey ideas and explore options.

 Skills to prepare and deliver technical presentations to senior leadership and/or investors in an inspiring way.

 A self-starter mindset: you take ownership, structure ambiguous problems yourself and deliver, reliably and on time.

 
 Preferred Qualifications

 A technical background and/or deep technical understanding of common development processes.

 
 Why Join Us 
 Shape the product from day one. Take a core PM role on the founding team of an ambitious AI healthcare startup, with real ownership over the product, how we work and, later, the product team.

 Make healthcare work better for everyone. Help people understand and act on their own health data, and give physicians and partners the tools to spend less time on admin and more on care.

 Grow in the heart of Zurich. Work side by side with the team in our collaborative office and benefit from our network of industry leaders, domain experts, top-tier talent and investors.

 
 Engagement Details
 
 This is a permanent, full-time position based in Zürich. We work in a hybrid setup, but strongly believe in the power and magic to collaborate most working days together in the office.

Location: Zaltbommel, Netherlands (Hybrid)
 Reporting to: VP of Marketing
 
 
 About Cyclomedia & The Role

 Cyclomedia creates digital representations of the real world, giving professionals the visual data they need to manage assets and infrastructure. We are currently sharpening our commercial strategy. To drive this, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the market.
 
 
 In our setup, Product Management builds the solution, and Product Marketing wins the market. As part of the Marketing department, you keep our messaging strictly focused on customer value. You own the value propositions, the customer context, and the commercial message. Your output forms the foundation for all our demand generation campaigns.

 The Role & Collaboration 

As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management. Armed with this market reality, you brief our Regional Marketing Managers and Content Marketers on the target audiences, messaging, and commercial hooks required for their campaigns. You also work with our Sales Enablement team to ensure sales representatives have the materials they need to close deals.
 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 
 Positioning & Messaging: Translate technical product capabilities into clear positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive pipeline value and improve lead conversion rates.

 Market Intelligence: Feed the product roadmap with market insights, buyer needs, and competitive intelligence.

 Sales Alignment: Validate marketing materials with regional sales teams so they are fully equipped to sell the solution.

 First 6 Months Impact: Work out the context for our top 6 value propositions and produce the foundational global marketing materials to guide upcoming demand and lead generation campaigns.

 

 Your Profile 
 
 
 Experience: 5+ years of Product Marketing experience, or a strong commercial background deeply embedded in our core markets.

 Domain Expertise (Preferred): A background in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or mobile mapping, or specific industry experience in utility companies, telecom network planning, public or network asset management, or engineering work planning.

 Commercial Acumen: A proven ability to look from the outside in. You base your strategies on what the buyer needs to hear rather than what the product can do.

 Ownership: You work independently and possess the maturity to help shape the Product Marketing function as we grow. 
 
 

 What We Offer 
 
 
 Room to make your mark: A challenging role in a strong, growing international company, with real freedom to shape the position.

 A great team to join: A small, close-knit and growing marketing team, plus experienced colleagues to build on.

 A competitive package: An attractive base salary and an 8.3% annual bonus scheme.

 Growth: Training, online courses and (team) coaching to support your development.

 Time off: 25 holidays, the option to buy up to 10 extra days a year, and an extra day off after Ascension Day.

 Wellbeing: A flexible Mental Health Day each year to rest and recharge, and a sports allowance of €25 gross per month.

 Hybrid working: 3 days in the office and 2 from home, with a home-working allowance of €2 per day.

 The right tools: A company phone and laptop.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description:
About Zego 🚀 
 At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

 We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖
 For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

 Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor .

 
 If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring. 
 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to join our Platform team. Platform powers every customer journey at Zego: the core services behind quoting, buying, paying for, changing, renewing and cancelling a policy.
 You’ll own a product domain within Platform, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping refine the longer-term platform strategy as we rebuild and modernise some of Zego’s most critical services. You’ll turn technical challenges into business value, and make sure your services are resilient, compliant and ready to be used by AI agents as well as our apps.
 
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals , and help refine the longer-term plans for Platform, balancing new capability, legacy rebuilds and reliability.

 Lead complex discovery autonomously as we modernise the policy lifecycle, moving capability off legacy systems one safe slice at a time.

 Dive deep into technical detail , understanding dependencies and failure modes, and making informed trade-offs with engineering.

 Treat internal teams as your customers , so launching a new product, price or journey on the platform is fast and predictable.

 Make your services AI-ready , with clean, well-documented APIs and data that agents and automations can use safely, and establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain.

 Put the right metrics in place , from reliability and incidents to time-to-launch and cost to serve, and build the business case for platform investment.

 Build compliance in from day one with Legal, Compliance and Finance, so money flows and customer communications are accurate and auditable.

 Bring stakeholders along , running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.

 
 What You’ll Need to Be Successful 
 Platform product ownership. A track record of owning a technical, platform or backend product domain and delivering material business impact in a high-growth environment.

 Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on system architecture, APIs, event-driven services and workflow orchestration. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science.

 Legacy modernisation. You’ve led incremental rebuilds of business-critical services while keeping the lights on.

 Data and commercial fluency. You use financial, behavioural and usage data to ground decisions, query Snowflake or Looker yourself, and can build the case for platform investment.

 Clarity in complexity. You untangle dependencies across multiple business domains and explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

 Regulated environment. Ideally, experience in insurance, payments, lending or financial services, with compliance built into product design.

 You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

 
 The Zego ways of working 🏡 
 Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.
 We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.
 Here is what the last one looked like .
 
 Benefits 🎁 
 💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.
 🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.
 📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

 Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions.

 Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

 We're looking for a Product Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us define and build purpose-built, highly differentiated shopping experiences across our growing portfolio of Retail categories.

 
What You'll Be Doing

 You'll be joining the Retail Categories team. Retail only wins category by category; a single, generic shopping experience cannot do justice to the unique ways people buy apparel, auto parts, or home improvement goods. This role owns the end-to-end category shopping experience for a defined portfolio, transforming broad customer promises into shipped surfaces and distinct emotional hooks that drive habitual buying behavior.

 Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

 
 
 Define Category Strategy: Formulate the category experience strategy and decide which categories and bets to invest in first, sequencing for maximum growth and impact.

 
 Execute Signature Product Bets: Translate each category's promise into concrete, testable product bets—such as personal-shopper features using doorstep returns for Apparel or fitment-accurate part lookup for Auto Parts—and ship them end to end.

 
 Optimise Category Surfaces: Own the category merchandising and storefront surfaces that differentiate one vertical from another while maintaining a cohesive and intuitive Retail experience.

 
 Leverage Platform Capabilities: Partner with shared platform infrastructure (such as doorstep returns or fulfillment) to build bespoke category experiences without rebuilding core infrastructure.

 
 Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner deeply with BD, Sales, Catalog, and Search teams to ensure category surfaces are powered by accurate data and align cleanly with merchant relationships.

 
 Measure Impact: Use data, customer insight, and experimentation to prioritise initiatives, define success metrics, and directly move the needle on conversion and repeat purchases.

 
 
What You'll Need to Thrive

 Essential

 
 
 Proven Consumer Product Experience: Demonstrated success in product management on consumer-facing products, ideally within e-commerce, marketplaces, or multi-sided platforms.

 
 Track Record of 0-to-1 Innovation: Proven ability to ship brand-new or highly differentiated shopping experiences, navigating ambiguity to break broad opportunities into focused, testable bets.

 
 Strong Analytical Capabilities: Comfort driving data-informed prioritisation, establishing robust success metrics, and utilising experimentation to measure category-level impact.

 
 Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Experience partnering closely with cross-functional product teams (Engineering, Design, Analytics) as well as commercial teams like BD and Sales to align business needs with product strategy.

 
 Customer-Obsessed Product Instinct: A natural intuition for customer behaviour, understanding what makes a shopping experience feel right and how to design the emotional hook that drives retention.

 
 Nice to Have

 
 
 Specialised Retail Domain Knowledge: Prior experience working with merchandising, category management, product detail pages (PDP), or specialised shopping flows.

 
 Data Structure Familiarity: Experience working alongside Catalog or Search product areas to power front-end surfaces with complex item data.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.
 Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data.
 About Us
 Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.
 Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.
 The Role
 You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work.
 Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked.
 We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging.
 What You'll Do
 Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them.
 Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads.
 Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
 Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
 Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
 Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.
 Hiring Process
 Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
 15-minute phone screen
 First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
 Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
 Culture fit (45 min)
 We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.
 Requirements 
 You Should Have
 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
 Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
 An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
 You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
 Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die Energiewirtschaft steckt mitten in der größten Transition ihrer Geschichte. Energieversorger, Netzbetreiber und Lösungsanbieter brauchen Software, die da mithält, und sie brauchen jemanden, der ihnen klar und glaubwürdig erklärt, warum epilot genau die richtige Plattform ist.
 Als Senior Product Marketing Manager bist du genau diese Stimme im Markt. Du gestaltest mit, wie wir epilot als zentrale, AI-native Plattform für die neue Energiewelt positionieren. Und du sorgst dafür, dass Marketing, Sales und Customer Success eine gemeinsame Geschichte erzählen.
 Product Marketing ist für dich das Fundament jeder Kommunikation und nicht nur der Lieferant für Slides und Battle Cards? Dann lies weiter.
 epilot ist das XRM für die Energiewirtschaft: Unsere Plattform verbindet nicht nur Kund:innen, sondern auch Partner, Installateure, Lieferanten und interne Teams. Über 200 Energieversorger und Netzbetreiber arbeiten bereits damit, und unser Team aus über 120 Menschen wächst weiter. Wenn du Teil dieser Journey sein und epilot an entscheidender Stelle voranbringen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!
 
 Das erwartet dich 
 Positionierung und Messaging der epilot Plattform liegen in deiner Verantwortung, für Energieversorger, Netzbetreiber und Lösungsanbieter. Produktfunktionen übersetzt du in Mehrwerte, die bei allen wichtigen Personas ankommen.

 Nah am Markt: In Sales-Calls, im Gespräch mit Kund:innen und auf Branchenevents erfährst du, was Energieversorger gerade umtreibt. Daraus hältst du ICPs, Personas und Wettbewerbsanalysen aktuell und machst sie zu Wissen, mit dem das ganze Unternehmen arbeitet.

 Produktkampagnen und Markteinführungen steuerst du inhaltlich, von der Story bis zu den Kernbotschaften, gemeinsam mit unserem Campaign & Growth Marketing. Auch die inhaltliche Qualität unserer Produktseiten und weitere produktnahe Inhalte liegt in deiner Verantwortung.

 Sales und Customer Success machst du sprechfähig: mit Pitch-Materialien, Argumentationshilfen, Einwandbehandlung und Trainings.

 AI-gestützte Workflows für Product Marketing baust du auf und entwickelst sie weiter, etwa für Persona- und Wettbewerbsanalysen, Messaging oder Sales-Materialien. AI ist für dich kein Knopfdruck: Die Logik dahinter entwickelst du selbst.

 Unsere Junior Product Marketing Managerin führst du fachlich und begleitest sie in ihrer Entwicklung.

 Strategy, Produktmanagement, Sales, Customer Success, Campaign & Growth sowie Event Marketing schätzen dich als Sparringspartner:in. 

 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Marketing , idealerweise im Product Marketing. Positionierung und Messaging hast du schon selbst verantwortet.

 Komplexe Produkte verstehst du schnell und erklärst sie einfach. Dabei findest du die Worte, bei denen Zielgruppen nicken, und nicht die, die nur intern gut klingen.

 Strategisch denken und selbst anpacken gehören für dich zusammen. Ein Messaging-Framework entwickelst du ebenso gern wie eine Produktseite oder einen Sales-Pitch. Auf ein Briefing wartest du nicht: Wo es eine klare Story braucht, bringst du sie auf den Weg.

 AI-Tools nutzt du nicht nur. Am liebsten baust du eigene Workflows, statt dich auf fertige Lösungen zu verlassen.

 Neugier auf die Energiewirtschaft ist entscheidend. Branchenerfahrung oder Wissen über Energieprozesse ist ein großes Plus, wichtiger ist aber deine Lust, tief einzutauchen.

 Überzeugungskraft: Stakeholder bis hin zum C-Level gewinnst du mit klaren Argumenten. Außerdem macht es dir Freude, andere fachlich zu begleiten und weiterzuentwickeln.

 Sprachen: Stilsicheres Deutsch auf C2-Niveau ist ein Muss, denn dein Messaging muss im deutschen Markt sitzen. Dazu sprichst du fließend Englisch, unsere Unternehmenssprache.

 
 Das bieten wir dir 
 Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote arbeiten, wann immer es passt, und regelmäßig in Köln zusammenkommen, wenn persönlicher Austausch zählt.

 Die Möglichkeit, die erfolgreichste SaaS-Plattform auf dem Energiemarkt mit aufzubauen.

 Start-up-Mentalität: dynamische Atmosphäre und großartiger Teamspirit.

 Ein stark wachsendes Unternehmen mit offener Kommunikationskultur, motivierten Kolleg:innen, und internationaler Unternehmenskultur

 Exponentielle Lernkurve – epilot wächst rasant, selbiges erwarten wir von dir

 Einen zentralen und modernen Standort im Herzen von Köln mit coolen Cafés direkt um die Ecke

 Transparenz – Wir pflegen eine sehr flache und offene Unternehmenskultur, alles ist einsehbar und steht zur Diskussion.

 Regelmäßige Teamevents wie bspw. zu Karneval, das Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier, Company breakfast und noch viel mehr Gelegenheiten deine epilot:innen auch außerhalb der Arbeitszeiten kennenzulernen

 Sportangebote wie Urban Sports Club, ein Gym um die Ecke u.v.m.

 
Immer noch nicht überzeugt? Hier unser Versprechen an alle zukünftigen epilot:innen 💙 promise.epilot.cloud/ 

 Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Herkunft, unabhängig von Geschlecht, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, Alt

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Sidetrade 
 Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.
 We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 
 Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion : Aimie Video 
 
 The role 
 As a Senior Project Manager, you run enterprise Order-to-Cash implementations from contract signature to go-live and into run. You own the plan, the coordination and the project governance. You deliver on time, on budget, and with a customer who is ready to use what we built.
 You join a Customer Experience team that holds its accounts from signature into renewal, alongside a Functional Expert, a Data Engineer and a Customer Success Manager. The customer keeps the same team throughout. You also arrive as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.
 Requirements 
 
 What you will do: 
 Run the project from kickoff to hypercare: plan, governance, weekly status calls and steering committees with finance leadership up to CFO.
 Deliver workshops on data mapping, integration and process design, train the customer to run UAT, and coordinate cutover, go-live strategy and business hypercare.
 Deliver against the baseline date agreed with the customer and the SOW budget, and keep the burn visible.
 Keep the commercial hygiene tight: billing milestones raised on time, change requests spotted and priced, effort tracked against the SOW.
 Coordinate the customer's finance, IT and ERP teams with our Functional Experts and Data Engineers through integration, testing and go-live.
 Lead complex programs, including multi-entity and phased rollouts, with several projects running in parallel at different phases.
 Raise risks early and bring a plan with them. Take the hard conversation on a slipped date or a scope dispute.
 Hand over to the Customer Success Manager at the transition into run, with the context Support needs.
 Keep phase, risk and milestones accurate in Salesforce and our project tools.
 Work with the AI agents that speed up our implementations, and check what they produce.
 
 What you will bring: 
 6+ years managing B2B SaaS, ERP or finance-system implementations, with enterprise projects that went live and stayed live.
 A strong command of project economics: SOW, budget, burn, change requests, billing milestones.
 Comfort in front of finance leadership, up to CFO, with good news and bad.
 Order-to-Cash, credit, collections or accounts receivable knowledge, or the proven ability to pick it up fast.
 The ability to hold several projects at different stages at once without dropping any of them.
 The candor to say the uncomfortable thing early, to the customer and to Sidetrade.
 Fluent English and French. German or Spanish is an advantage.
 Willingness to travel up to 50%.
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field.
 
 Why Sidetrade 
 AI-native. We are not a software vendor bolting AI onto a legacy product. Aimie IQ and our AI agents are built on the largest proprietary Order-to-Cash Data Lake.
 Measurable impact. You work with enterprise finance teams on problems tied directly to cash and working capital.
 Build the method. You join as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.
 Benefits 
 Hybrid work model – a flexible mix of in-office and remote days 
 Great culture – active Social Club organizing regular team events and activities
 Health & wellness – medical coverage, life insurance, and other wellness programs 
 Time off – competitive paid holidays plus public holidays 
 Career growth & compensation – competitive salary, equal opportunities, Edenred card, learning & mentorship programs, and advancement support 
 
 Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 
 We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate.
 If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know. 
 Agencies 
 We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.
